title: Read the open titles
prompt: TaskItem, ITaskReader and two readers are supplied. Write public static async Task<List<string>> OpenTitlesAsync(ITaskReader reader). Read the tasks once and return the titles of those that are not done, in order. When the reader throws InvalidOperationException, return an empty list.
hints: Which line can fail, and where does its exception appear?
Await the read inside a try. Catch the one exception type that means the reader is offline.
After a successful read, collect the Title of every task whose Done is false. In the catch, return a new empty List<string>.
checks: Run(new MemoryReader(new List<TaskItem> { new TaskItem(1, "Pack", "Ana", true), new TaskItem(2, "Ship", "", false), new TaskItem(3, "Label", "Ben", false) })).SequenceEqual(new List<string> { "Ship", "Label" })
checkLabels: Only the titles of tasks that are not done must be returned, in order.
A reader with no tasks must give an empty list.
An offline reader must give an empty list.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Awaits the read with nothing to handle an offline reader.
Returns every title, including the done tasks.

feedback: Check the offline reader and the reader with one done task separately. The first tests your catch and the second tests your filter.
